text: Hana's daughter starts primary school on Monday. Remind me to text Hana that morning to see how drop-off went.
Jun invited me to his housewarming on Saturday at 7pm. The new flat is in Leith, near the shore.
Aidan graduates from Glasgow on the 14th at 11am. His parents are flying over from Cork for it.
Ravi's son Dev has his GCSE maths exam on Thursday morning. Ravi says he's been really anxious about it and barely sleeping.
Irina mentioned she's vegetarian now, so bear that in mind for the dinner.
Don't forget to buy a card for Aneesh the day before his graduation.
Dinner at Noor's on Friday at 8. She said not to bring anything, but I'll take wine anyway.
Matteo's leaving party has been called off because half the team are off sick. They're going to rearrange for sometime in November.
Adaeze passed her driving test this morning on the second attempt! She's thrilled.
Emil and his wife are hosting a barbecue on Sunday afternoon for their son's fifth birthday. Need to pick up a present on Saturday.
Kalani's twins start nursery next week. She's more nervous about it than they are.
Spoke to Olivia. Her brother Ryan is getting his A-level results on Thursday. Remind me to ask her how he got on the next day.
Gustavo is into vintage cameras, mostly old Pentax ones. He mentioned the K1000 a couple of times, which feels like a hint for his birthday.
Francesca's engagement party is on the 22nd at half 7, at the Italian place on Bridge Street. Plus-ones welcome.
Naledi has her viva on Wednesday at 2pm. I should send her a good luck message that morning.
Kwame's cat Biscuit had an operation on her leg yesterday. He's picking her up from the vet tomorrow evening.
Ioana is throwing a surprise 40th for her husband on the 3rd. I'm in charge of the playlist, and she wants everyone there by 6.
Owen started at the new school today. His mum said he came home quiet and didn't want to talk about it. Remind me to check in with her at the weekend.
Pick up dry cleaning before Friday at 5. Shirt for the wedding is in there.
Wei's graduation ceremony is on the 9th at 10am, then lunch with the family afterwards. Must remember to send flowers that evening.
Barbara told me her granddaughter Layla is off to university in York next month. First one in the family to go.
Milan and Svetlana are having people round for dinner on Saturday. Starts at 7, and I said I'd bring dessert.
Lachlan has a big presentation at work on Tuesday morning and is dreading it. Remind me to text him good luck on Monday evening, then ask how it went on Wednesday.
Gareth said his dad retires at the end of the month. They're doing a meal at the golf club on the 30th.

Abigail's son Chidi is in the school play on Thursday at 6pm. He's playing the wolf and has been practising his howl all week, much to the annoyance of their neighbours. Abigail can't get the afternoon off, so her husband Ryan is taking him. Remind me to ask Abigail on Friday how it went, and whether anyone filmed it.
Farah mentioned she's struggling a lot with her dissertation. The deadline is the 18th and she feels behind.
Jakub is having a housewarming on the 26th from 4pm. Need to get him a plant or something for the new place.
Hana and Jun are expecting their second baby in March! They told everyone at Aidan's party last night.
Ravi said his sister Irina just got into medical school. Remind me to send her a card.
Noor's mum is having knee surgery on Monday. Noor is taking the week off to look after her.
Book the dentist for after half term. Ideally a morning, before 10.
Matteo loves Japanese whisky. He's also been learning to cook ramen from scratch, and apparently it's going badly.
Called Adaeze. Her nephew's christening is on Sunday at 11, and she asked if I could take photos. I said yes.
Emil's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam on the 12th at half 9. Remind me to ask him how she did that afternoon.
Kalani says Olivia is moving to Bristol in the new year for her husband's job. She's not thrilled about leaving everyone behind.
Went to Gustavo's 50th last night. Great evening. Francesca was there with her new partner, Kwame Haddad, who teaches at the same school as Gustavo.
Naledi's son Owen has his first football match for the under-nines on Saturday morning. Kick-off is at 9:30.

Ioana's book club dinner is postponed indefinitely because her landlord is doing work on the kitchen. Barbara is hosting a smaller get-together at hers instead, on Thursday at 7. We're reading the new Sally Rooney, and I haven't started it yet. Barbara is gluten free, so whatever I bake needs to be too.
Don't forget: Wei's daughter graduates from nursery on Friday at 2. Wei wants a few of us there for the little ceremony, and there's cake afterwards.
Milan's dog Pepper has gone missing. He's been out looking since this morning and is beside himself.
Need to ring Lachlan on Sunday about the dinner plans for his mum's 70th.
Svetlana told me her son Jakub got a first in his engineering degree. The graduation is in July.
Garden centre on Saturday morning, then the tip. Nothing else planned for the weekend, thank goodness.
Gareth and Abigail's anniversary dinner on Saturday has been cancelled. Their babysitter fell through, so they're doing a takeaway at home instead.
Chidi is sitting his eleven-plus on the 15th. His mum says he's surprisingly calm about it. I should drop off a good luck card the day before.
Farah's housewarming is next Saturday at 3pm. She's just moved into a two-bed in Chorlton with her girlfriend, Hana Morris.
Lunch with Aidan. He's training for the Edinburgh marathon in May, and he's also started volunteering at a food bank on Tuesdays.
Remind me to message Jun the week after his son's first day at secondary school to ask how he's settling in.
Ravi's wife Noor is starting her new job as a deputy head on Monday. Ravi says she's nervous but excited. I should text her on Sunday evening.
Irina said her boss is leaving and she might be up for his role. She has an interview on the 4th at 10am. She seemed fairly relaxed about it.

Aneesh's grandad passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is next Friday at 1pm. Aneesh is flying back to Delhi on Wednesday to be with the family. Remind me to check in with him over the weekend and, if he's back by then, take him for a coffee the week after.

Mrs Tanaka next door is having a little party for her 80th on Sunday afternoon in the church hall. Her son Kalani is coming up from London for it with his kids, and she asked me to help set up that morning from about 10. Must remember to buy her some lilies on Saturday, since she said roses make her sneeze.
Note for later: Olivia hates surprises, so no surprise party for her birthday.

Spoke to Dr Petrov about Matteo. He's recovering well after the operation and should be home by Thursday, though he'll need physio twice a week for a while. His partner Jakub is working from home to look after him. I'll visit him on Friday afternoon, and maybe take him some of those almond biscuits he likes.

Big dinner at Francesca and Gustavo's on the 19th at 7:30 to celebrate their daughter finishing her PhD. Dress code is smart casual, and Francesca said she'd sort a taxi back for anyone who needs one. I'm sharing a ride with Naledi and Kwame there and then making my own way home later.

Kwame's niece Ioana has her ballet recital on Saturday at 4pm and he asked if I'd like to come. I said yes. Remind me to get her some flowers that morning and to text Kwame the next day to say thank you.

Wei says Uncle Milan's sixtieth is on the 28th, a big family lunch in Chinatown. Wei's brother is flying in from Singapore the night before, and it's the first time they'll all be together since the wedding three years ago. Wei is a bit stressed because she's organising the whole thing. I should ask her on the Monday after how it all went.
Picked up the new running shoes. Need to return the old pair to the shop by the 31st.

Lachlan has started learning Portuguese because his partner's family are from Porto. He's going over to meet them for the first time at Christmas, flying out on the 22nd and staying for a week. He's nervous about the language barrier and about her dad, who apparently doesn't say much. He's doing an evening class on Wednesdays and an app on the side.

Svetlana's daughter Layla is starting her first proper job on Monday at an architecture firm in Leeds. Svetlana is clearly so proud. Remind me to send Layla a quick message that evening to ask how her first day went, and then check in again the week after when she's settled.
